title: Card-Funded Reservation Deposits and the Activated Hold — Homesite Reservation
content:
How a Homesite Reservation's reservation deposit was paid sets the activation card shortening of the activated hold. The reading is made from the payments received on the reservation ledger with the component reservation deposit, summing those payments and the part of them paid by card.

**Rule.** The activation card shortening is **2** days where card payments make up the whole reservation deposit received, **1** day where card payments make up part but not all of it, and zero where no part of it was paid by card. Card convenience fees are their own component and never count as reservation deposit paid by card.

## Ledger illustrations (hypothetical)

| Reservation deposit payments on the ledger | Card share of the deposit received | Shortening |
|---|---|---|
| 1500.00 by card | whole | 2 days |
| 1000.00 by card and 500.00 by ACH | part | 1 day |
| 2500.00 by wire | none | zero |
| 1000.00 by ACH, plus a card convenience fee entry | none (the convenience fee is not reservation deposit) | zero |

Payments booked to the premium holding fee or to any fee component are not part of this reading, whatever their method.
